description: This file implements the DU Ue Controller logic, including RLF detection handling, adapter classes for MAC and RLC notifications, and UE activity management functions.

classes.name: mac_rlf_du_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class for MAC RLF notifications, triggers RLF detection handling in DU manager.

classes.name: rlc_rlf_du_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class for RLC RLF notifications, dispatches RLF detection to DU manager execution context.

classes.name: du_ue_controller_impl::rlf_state_machine
classes.description: State machine managing RLF detection, timer, and UE release logic.

classes.name: du_ue_controller_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the DU UE Controller, managing UE activities, RLF detection, and related timers.

methods.name: get_rlf_cause_str
methods.description: Converts RLF cause enum to string description.

methods.name: handle_rlf_detection
methods.description: Handles RLF detection event, manages timers and UE release process.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_detection
methods.description: Handles C-RNTI C/E detection, potentially resets RLF timer.

methods.name: get_release_timeout
methods.description: Calculates the timeout duration for RLF timer based on UE state.

methods.name: trigger_ue_release
methods.description: Triggers UE release request upon RLF timer expiry.

methods.name: stop_ue_drb_activity
methods.description: Stops all DRB activities for the UE.

methods.name: handle_activity_stop_request
methods.description: Handles request to stop UE activity, disables RLF detection.

methods.name: run_in_ue_executor
methods.description: Dispatches a task to run within the UE control executor context.
